rule: The version is the newest release below. A release email to dealers is only ever sent after the President approves that release's email in Connect 360 — a deploy never sends one.

releases.title: Golden Service & Support, shipment details and a Help Center

items.text: Golden Service & Support: parts lookup, Golden publications, training videos and service requests in one place (where available for your account).
Orders & Tracking can list several shipments per order, with carrier tracking links and confirmed dates.
New Help & Training Center and What's New.
Account Center shows three separate facts per manufacturer: account number on file, verified by HCPS, and authorized to order — with applications and holds shown apart.
Reports keeps its tabs (Overview, Total Sales, Orders & Tracking) while you move between them.
UPS tracking numbers open the carrier's tracking page.
Quotes and brochures show the manufacturer's reference price and never allow a price below a minimum advertised price.
